name: Clackamas River (Lower)
blurb: Portland-area summer floats below Estacada, with a quieter upper run and a busy Barton-to-Carver tube stretch on hot weekends.

sections.notes: The quieter of the two listed floats. Cold water and moving current still demand a properly fitted PFD. Arrange a two-vehicle shuttle between McIver and Barton.
The busy summer tube stretch, especially on hot weekends. Parking can fill early at Barton and Carver. Arrange a shuttle before launching.
